name: travel-planner
description: AI travel planner that co-designs itineraries with users and generates a zoomable map plus a route image.

displayDescription.en: Co-designs itineraries with you, then generates a zoomable map and a route image with a text itinerary.
displayDescription.zh: 和你一起逐条敲定目的地、天数、预算与偏好，定制专属行程，并一键生成可缩放地图与带文字行程的路线图。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想规划一次旅行，请一步步帮我确认细节，最后生成可缩放地图和带文字行程的路线图。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to plan a trip. Help me confirm the details step by step, then generate a zoomable map and a route image with a text itinerary.

quickPrompts.en: I want to plan a trip. Help me confirm the details step by step, then generate a zoomable map and a route image with a text itinerary.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想规划一次旅行，请一步步帮我确认细节，最后生成可缩放地图和带文字行程的路线图。
